scope: Read-only canonical-source identity analysis of retained OpenAPI generated snapshot findings; no optimization implementation or performance decision.
acceptance: Preserve every original ID and exact finding record. Use only currently pending retained findings under the explicit OpenApi source-generator snapshots directory.
Capture both pinned source revisions, full native Git command receipts and whole-source SHA256/byte identities before accepting alias identities.
Roslyn parses each exact snapshot and locates the actual method containing its reported source span. The reported snippet must be present in that span and occur once in the containing method.

Require the complete containing method's non-trivia C# token kind/text identity and containing type, the same card and same normalized snippet. Do not collapse distinct operations just because a class/file/card or GetParameters name is shared.

Prove the complete containing method text is present in a literal chunk of the actual generator producer's interpolated raw string. A matching snapshot fragment alone is not generator ownership evidence.
Require each grouped finding's Original and Default containing-method identities to match and retain full source snapshots, actual span, method and generator-literal evidence.

Choose the lowest original numeric ID per proven group as the canonical still-pending study. Alias identities create no new gain/confidence claim; distinct fixture data and other source patterns remain distinct.

Canonical findings remain pending and retain their own unused timing budgets. No alias is called fixed, measured no-gain or an extra optimization. Do not infer safety, producer execution frequency or performance from source identity.

No benchmark, timing, server, machine setting, shipping source/config change, public API, permanent test, source branch publication, PR or browser launch. A small isolated syntax-analysis utility is not a benchmark.
Do not advance any alias ledger entry before fork-only immutable evidence publication and exact remote identity/index proof. Preserve all earlier cases and the fixed classified report.
